applied_rules.official_template: source/build.mjs adapts original pptxgenjs-build-template.mjs directly, retaining validation, one source-to-slide transform, and connectExactPath/connectOneWay/connectBothWays helpers.
applied_rules.ownership: Every plate, label and relation is native; INSETS empty. No bitmap background or tracing layer.
applied_rules.topology: NODES/EDGES/INSETS per page; from/to/direction and explicit path; final segment endArrowType targets destination.
applied_rules.native_geometry: Standard editable rectangles, ellipses, textboxes and exact native line-arrow paths. No freeform path clouds.
applied_rules.z_order: Earth/water region plates first -> exact path relations -> standard textboxes; prevents filled scientific regions hiding arrows.

changes: Original single-image reconstruction explicitly extended to five new Japanese concept diagrams. Concept labels and scientific relationships retained. Final terrain simplified to standard rectangular region plates with a river-channel notch, under original portable phase-one geometry limits; not a calibrated landscape section. Source map is adjacent input.json. Locked dependency manifest included for a normal Node installation.
runtime_probe: Original probe passed with bundled Python3.12 ahead of LibreOffice3.8 Python on local PATH and LibreOffice24.2.5.2 executable available. PptxGenJS4.0.1 resolves from the source task directory.
